documents.text: SS Adriatic (1871) SS "Adriatic" was the first of two White Star Line ocean liners to carry the name "Adriatic". The White Star Line's first four steamships, the ("Oceanic" (I), "Atlantic", "Baltic", and the "Republic") met with great success in the trans-Atlantic market, and the line decided to build two more. The first of these was the SS "Adriatic", which was built by Harland and Wolff and launched on 17 October 1871; the second was the "Celtic".
